_comment: Site settings, read by scripts/build_seo.py. Edit here once and re-run the
script; the values are written into index.html and every page under city/.
An environment variable of the same name in capitals overrides any of these
for a single run, e.g.  SITE_URL=https://staging.example.com python3 scripts/build_seo.py
siteUrl   the address the site is actually served on. Every canonical tag,
Open Graph URL and sitemap entry is built from it, so it must
match reality — a canonical pointing elsewhere tells Google to
index that other address instead of yours.
gscToken  Google Search Console's HTML-tag verification value. Paste the
bare token, the whole <meta> tag, or the content="..." part.
gaId      Google Analytics 4 measurement ID, the G-XXXXXXXXXX one. Leave
empty and no analytics code is emitted at all.
gaAnonymiseIp  send IP addresses truncated. On by default.
